title: RC tight minimum attribution
qualification: Use separately minimized equation (18), not equation (8) alone. Keep balance-only and two-jet feasible classes distinct.

title: Balanced-lift norm exponent
qualification: The counterfamily lower bound concerns squared norm/energy; its unsquared exponent is half as large. It is not a lower bound for the exact native minimizer.

title: Harmonic initial interval
qualification: Use the specified interval (0,1/M) when M is merely an upper support bound; do not call it the entire first mesh cell without the actual mesh hypothesis.

title: N32 source coverage
qualification: The finite inverse contains all 65 edges and eleven prime bases, not ten.

title: Infinite strong-residual domain
qualification: For unbounded A, the bounded trial map Y has range in Dom(A), with AY bounded; form-domain membership alone does not define the Hilbert residual B-AY.

title: Strict selected receipt acceptance
qualification: Use the authenticated pass-four replay wrapper for selected receipts; preserve the original parser and its duplicate-key/numeric-alias defect as history, not a numerical refutation.
